name: cavalry
description: Build professional, beat-synced motion graphics in Cavalry from the shell with the cav CLI. Cav is a community plugin and is not affiliated with Cavalry, Scene Group, or Canva.

interface.longDescription: Plan, build and render motion graphics in a running Cavalry app from the shell with the cav CLI: logo stings, kinetic type, lower thirds, charts, UI walkthroughs, transitions and animations synced to music. Needs Cavalry 2.4 or newer on macOS or Windows, the cav CLI, and the cav-bridge script open in Cavalry. Cav is a community plugin and is not affiliated with Cavalry, Scene Group, or Canva.
capabilities: Render frames, contact sheets and MP4 video
Check scenes for common motion-design mistakes
defaultPrompt: Make a 4-second logo sting for my startup in Cavalry.
Animate a lower third for an interview in Cavalry.
